name: dropdown-menu-icons
title: Dropdown Menu: Icons
description: Combine icons with labels for quick scanning.

files.content:
import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export const DropdownMenuIcons = () => (
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Open</DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuContent>
      <DropdownMenuList>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Icon name="user" />
          Profile
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Icon name="credit-card" />
          Billing
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Icon name="settings-01" />
          Settings
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem variant="error">
          <Icon name="log-out" />
          Log out
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuList>
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenu>
);
